callsign.purpose: Tracked-uppercase console/panel position labels. Functional nomenclature, not decorative eyebrows.

readout.purpose: Mono telemetry: metrics, IDs, timestamps, clocks. Tabular.

shadows.name: seam
shadows.purpose: Default panel seating in the room.

shadows.name: lit-inner
shadows.purpose: Top highlight on illuminated status tiles.

motion.name: ease-instrument
motion.purpose: Default settle for state transitions and panel entrance.

components.name: Primary Button (GO)
components.description: The affirmative action — proceed, submit, approve.
components.css: .ds-btn-go { background:#0E7A3C; color:#fff; padding:10px 18px; border:none; border-radius:3px; font-family:'Public Sans',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.8125rem; letter-spacing:0.02em; transition:background .15s, transform .1s; } .ds-btn-go:hover{ background:#17A34A; } .ds-btn-go:active{ transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-go:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid rgba(14,122,60,0.45); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Tile — GO
components.description: Atomic lit state indicator. Variants swap fill: GO green, OBSERVE blue, HOLD amber, NO-GO red.
components.css: .ds-tile{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:2px; font-family:'Archivo Expanded','Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.625rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.30); } .ds-tile-dot{ width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-tile-go{ background:#17A34A; }

components.name: Status Tile — Idle
components.description: Unlit state: neutral well, ink-muted label.
components.css: .ds-tile-idle{ background:#EDEFEB; color:#7C817A; box-shadow:none; border:1px solid rgba(24,27,24,0.12); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:2px; font-family:'Archivo Expanded','Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.625rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-tile-dot-idle{ width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:9999px; background:#A7ABA4; }

components.name: Console Panel
components.description: Instrument panel with a call-sign rail. Seated on a hairline seam, not floated.
components.html:
TASK DISTRIBUTIONFIDO-01
Panel content
components.css: .ds-panel{ background:#F6F7F4; border:1px solid rgba(24,27,24,0.12); border-radius:4px; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(24,27,24,0.02), 0 1px 2px rgba(24,27,24,0.06); overflow:hidden; } .ds-panel-rail{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(24,27,24,0.08); background:#EDEFEB; } .ds-callsign{ font-family:'Archivo Expanded','Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.6875rem; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#181B18; } .ds-desig{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:0.625rem; color:#7C817A; } .ds-led{ width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:9999px; background:#17A34A; margin-left:auto; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(23,163,74,0.18); } .ds-panel-body{ padding:20px; color:#181B18; font-family:'Public Sans',sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; }

components.name: Readout
components.description: A single telemetry reading: mono value + call-sign label.
components.css: .ds-readout{ padding:14px 16px; background:#F6F7F4; border:1px solid rgba(24,27,24,0.12); border-radius:4px; } .ds-readout-val{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-weight:600; font-size:1.75rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#181B18; line-height:1; } .ds-readout-label{ margin-top:8px; font-family:'Archivo Expanded','Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.625rem; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7C817A; }

components.name: Input Field
components.css: .ds-input{ width:100%; background:#EAEDE9; border:1px solid rgba(24,27,24,0.12); border-radius:3px; padding:10px 14px; color:#181B18; font-family:'Public Sans',sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder{ color:#7C817A; } .ds-input:focus{ outline:none; border-color:#0E7A3C; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #0E7A3C; }

components.name: Console Nav Item
components.description: Rail navigation item with a GO-green position marker when active.
components.css: .ds-nav{ position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:3px; font-family:'Public Sans',sans-serif; font-size:0.8125rem; color:#565B54; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav:hover{ background:#EDEFEB; color:#181B18; } .ds-nav-active{ color:#181B18; font-weight:600; background:#EDEFEB; } .ds-nav-mark{ position:absolute; left:0; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); width:2px; height:16px; background:#0E7A3C; border-radius:2px; }

narrative.overview: Onramp is one mission — a developer joining a codebase and reaching productive orbit — watched from a room full of consoles. Every role is a seat reading the same telemetry from a different position. The room is lit, not dark: a daylit operations floor with cool console-gray walls, near-white instrument panels seamed with hairlines, ink nomenclature, and a disciplined signal palette where color means status. It refuses both the near-black neon dashboard and the airy white minimal. Equipment, not ambience.
keyCharacteristics: Light fluorescent ops-room ground; panels seamed by hairlines, not floated on shadow.
Color is semantic only — GO / telemetry / caution / abort.
Console nomenclature: tracked-uppercase call-signs naming real positions.
Illuminated status tiles carry state (GO / NO-GO / HOLD / STANDBY).
Monospace is telemetry, never a technical costume.
Rectilinear geometry, radii <=4px; mission timeline and big board are signatures.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Color means status, never brand decoration. If a colored pixel is not reporting GO / telemetry / caution / abort, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Lit Rule
rules.body: Saturated fills are reserved for lit status tiles and the primary action. Everything else lives in the neutral room.

rules.name: The Nomenclature Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase names a real position (a call-sign) only. It never appears as a generic eyebrow over ordinary sections.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Anything measured, counted, timed, or identified is mono and tabular. Prose is never mono.

rules.name: The Seated Rule
rules.body: Panels are seated on a 1px seam, not floated on soft shadows. Lift is a response to hover or a genuine z-layer.

dos: Do keep saturated color to lit status tiles and the primary GO action; leave the rest in the neutral room.
Do set every measured value in JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums.
Do label panels and positions with tracked-uppercase call-signs that name a real position.
Do seat panels on a 1px ink-seam; reserve shadow-lift for hover and modals.
Do render onboarding progress as a mission timeline and leadership metrics as a big-board plot.
Do keep corners near-square (<=4px) and dividers as hairline rules.
donts: Don't use color as decoration — no accent washes, gradient text, or glowing edges.
Don't put tracked-uppercase eyebrows over ordinary sections; call-signs name positions only.
Don't float cards on soft drop-shadows at rest, or nest cards inside cards.
Don't reintroduce the dark ground, the amber-glow accent, or Instrument Serif.
Don't use monospace as a technical costume for non-data text.
Don't add colored left-border rails or borders >=2px on panels, list items, or alerts.
